import pathlib,socket,subprocess,time,signal,json,urllib.request,tarfile,gzip
root=pathlib.Path('/tmp/wukongim-migration-original-empty-source');root.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
held=[];ports=[]
for i in range(4):
 s=socket.socket();s.bind(('127.0.0.1',0));ports.append(s.getsockname()[1]);held.append(s)
config=f'''mode: debug
rootDir: {root}
dataDir: {root}/data
addr: tcp://127.0.0.1:{ports[0]}
httpAddr: 127.0.0.1:{ports[1]}
wsAddr: ws://127.0.0.1:{ports[2]}
manager:
  on: false
demo:
  on: false
logger:
  level: 2
  dir: {root}/logs
plugin:
  socketPath: {root}/plugin.sock
cluster:
  nodeId: 1
  addr: tcp://127.0.0.1:{ports[3]}
  serverAddr: 127.0.0.1:{ports[3]}
  apiUrl: http://127.0.0.1:{ports[1]}
  slotCount: 4
  slotReplicaCount: 1
  channelReplicaCount: 1
db:
  shardNum: 2
'''
(root/'source.yaml').write_text(config)
for s in held:s.close()
log=(root/'process.log').open('wb')
p=subprocess.Popen(['/tmp/wukongim-v2-original-a888f895','--config',str(root/'source.yaml')],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
trace=[]
try:
 deadline=time.monotonic()+45
 while 'server started successfully' not in (root/'process.log').read_text():
  if p.poll() is not None or time.monotonic()>deadline:raise RuntimeError('source readiness failed')
  time.sleep(.2)
 def call(path,data):
  req=urllib.request.Request(f'http://127.0.0.1:{ports[1]}'+path,data=json.dumps(data).encode(),headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'})
  with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=10) as r:res=json.load(r)
  trace.append({'path':path,'request':data,'response':res});return res
 call('/user/token',{'uid':'emptyalice','token':'synthetic-emptyalice','device_flag':1,'device_level':1})
 call('/channel',{'channel_id':'emptygroup','channel_type':2,'subscribers':['emptyalice']})
 call('/conversation/sync',{'uid':'emptyalice','msg_count':10})
 (root/'api.json').write_text(json.dumps(trace,indent=2))
 print(json.dumps(trace[-1]),flush=True)
finally:
 p.send_signal(signal.SIGINT);p.wait(timeout=20);log.close()
with open(root/'original-v2-empty.tar.gz','wb') as out:
 with gzip.GzipFile(fileobj=out,mode='wb',mtime=0) as gz:
  with tarfile.open(fileobj=gz,mode='w') as tar:
   for f in sorted((root/'data').rglob('*')):
    tar.add(f,arcname=str(f.relative_to(root/'data')),recursive=False)
